headline: Ashok Leyland appoints Venkatesan Venkataraman as director
summary: Ashok Leyland's Board appointed Venkatesan Venkataraman as an Additional Director (Non-Executive Non-Independent), effective November 14, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. He is currently President of Hinduja Automotive Limited.

headline: Sudal Industries Q2FY27: Net profit at ₹9.09 lakh
summary: Sudal Industries reported a net profit of ₹9.09 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹65.24 lakh in Q2FY26, while revenue from operations rose 26.4% YoY to ₹5,684.74 lakh.

headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn company secretary Gawankar resigns
summary: Vineet Gawankar has resigned as company secretary and compliance officer of Gujarat Themis Biosyn, effective close of business on November 30, 2026. He tendered the resignation to pursue opportunities outside the organisation.

headline: Kothari Industrial Q2FY27 results: net loss widens
summary: Kothari Industrial Corporation reported a standalone net loss of ₹1,319.09 lakhs for Q2FY27, wider than ₹604.05 lakhs a year ago, as revenue from operations rose to ₹5,673.25 lakhs.

headline: Sanchay Finvest reports no fund deviation for Q2FY27
summary: Sanchay Finvest Limited reported no deviation in use of preferential issue proceeds for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Funds of 4,85,00,000 lakhs were raised on February 9, 2026, and the filing records no variation in their use.
